About AL BassmarGet a Quote

AL Bassmar Water Tanks

A water tank supplier for projects across the UAE

AL Bassmar Water Tanks supplies building owners, contractors, accommodation operators, and industrial facilities across all seven emirates. Our range includes fiberglass and polyethylene water tanks, septic tanks, and custom-built GRP panel tanks.

The right tank depends on what it will hold and where it will go. For a rooftop or ground-level installation, we can help you compare capacities and footprints. For a basement or plant room with restricted access, we can discuss a sectional GRP tank assembled on site.

Share your target capacity, installation dimensions, and delivery location when you enquire. Our team can use those details to narrow down your options and confirm dimensions, availability, and pricing.

Explore Our Products

Applications

Where Tanks Are Used

Water tanks serve homes, commercial buildings, factories, and construction projects. The right setup depends on how the water will be used, how much you need, and where the tank will go.

Rooftop and Ground-Level Storage

Store water for everyday use in villas, apartment buildings, and commercial properties. Tank layout depends on the space available and the route for delivery.

Fire Protection Water Reserves

Keep a dedicated water supply for a building's fire protection system. The project's fire protection design determines the required capacity and tank arrangement.

Plant Rooms and Basements

Bring GRP panels through restricted access routes and assemble the tank inside the building, where bringing in a complete tank may be difficult.

Staff Accommodation

Provide shared water storage for accommodation blocks. Size the tank around occupancy, expected daily demand, and the water supply schedule.

Industrial Process and Cooling Water

Store water for production, equipment cooling, and other plant operations. Select the tank material and capacity to suit the process and water quality requirements.

Construction and Temporary Sites

Set up water storage for site activities such as equipment washdown and dust control, with capacity suited to the project's daily demand.
